verdicts.reason: Provisional miss, window closes 2030. IATA: SAF ~1 Mt in 2024 and ~2 Mt (0.7% of fuel) expected in 2025; the article itself puts 2024 at ~0.5%. EU/UK mandates are 2% in 2025 and 6% (EU) in 2030, so a global 5% by 2030 is very unlikely.

evidence.title: Policy Shortcomings Puts SAF Production at Risk (IATA)
evidence.shows: SAF production expected at 2 Mt in 2025, 0.7% of airline fuel consumption.

evidence.title: Cleaner jet fuel (MIT TR10 2025)
evidence.shows: Availability 'Now'; ~0.5% of 2024 jet fuel non-fossil; EU/UK 2% mandate from 2025.

verdicts.reading: Robots that learn new tasks quickly via generative-AI (foundation-model) training are in routine use at the 2025 edition year.
verdicts.mainstream_test: Would be: at least 20% of newly deployed industrial/service robots trained with generative/foundation-model policies by 2027 (routine-use test).
verdicts.reason: No public measure of the share of deployed robots using learned foundation-model policies. Looked for: IFR World Robotics (542,000 industrial robots installed in 2024, 4.66 million operational) does not break out AI-trained or generative-policy robots; no survey or vendor-neutral count of foundation-model robot deployments (Covariant, Agility, TRI) was found. Deployments named in the article are pilots, which suggests a small share, but no figure supports a verdict.

evidence.title: Global robot demand in factories doubles over 10 years (IFR)
evidence.shows: 542,000 installations in 2024, 4,664,000 in operation; no AI-training breakdown.

evidence.title: Fast-learning robots (MIT TR10 2025)
evidence.shows: Availability 'Now'; Agility, Amazon, Covariant, Robust, TRI.
